items.title: Angel One: Breakout above 23,200 in Nifty may signal short-term trend shift
items.description: Hitesh Rathi of Angel One has said that unless Nifty delivers a convincing breakout above the 23,150-23,200 band, caution remains warranted.

items.title: Stocks to watch: RIL, Jio Platforms, NTPC, Muthoot Finance, Bank of Baroda
items.description: Shares of NTPC, NTPC Green Energy, Muthoot Finance, Bank of Baroda, PB Fintech and CDSL will remain in focus after the companies reported their September quarter (Q2FY27) results.

items.title: Indian stocks may recover on steady growth, earnings, says Axis AMC
items.description: The Nifty 50 has fallen about 12% so far in 2026 after 10 straight years of gains, pressured by higher oil prices following the US-Israeli war on Iran and record foreign outflows of $31.3 billion

items.title: Asian shares slide as AI spending worries mount ahead of tech earnings
items.description: Concerns about negative cash ​flow and the sheer scale of AI capex saw the cost of insuring against corporate defaults ​blow out last week

items.title: How will US midterms impact Indian equities, bond yields, crude oil?
items.description: Historically, US equities have performed strongly following midterm elections. The S&P 500 has gained an average of around 6 per cent over the subsequent 60 trading days, data shows.
